name: file-offset-inclusive
script: file offset "abc" in POSIX file "$FILES/offset.txt" with inclusive

name: file-offset-starting-at
script: file offset "1" in POSIX file "$FILES/offset.txt" starting at 5

name: file-offset-utf16
script: file offset "é" in POSIX file "$FILES/utf16le-bom.txt" encoding "UTF-16"

name: file-offset-utf16le
script: file offset "é" in POSIX file "$FILES/utf16le-bom.txt" encoding "UTF-16LE"

name: file-offset-latin1
script: file offset "é" in POSIX file "$FILES/latin1.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-tilde-free-posix-append
script:
writetext "a" to "$TMP/w-append.txt"
writetext "b" to "$TMP/w-append.txt" with append
readtext "$TMP/w-append.txt"
